# AdaptiveMapShell

Map-engine-neutral layout driven by its container, not the browser viewport. Give the shell a definite height (or a bounded parent for its default `height: 100%`). The old 448px minimum has been removed so a short landscape host can constrain it.

- **Import:** `import { AdaptiveMapShell } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Product SDK
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/product-sdk-adaptivemapshell--docs>

## Example

From its `PanelAtEnd` story.

```tsx
import { InfoCircle as Info } from "@kozmos-ds/icons";
import {
  AdaptiveMapShell,
  MapControlButton,
  ThemeProvider,
} from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function AdaptiveMapShellExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <AdaptiveMapShell
        className="h-[42rem]"
        controls={
          <MapControlButton
            icon={<Info className="h-5 w-5" />}
            label="Map information"
            onClick={() => undefined}
          />
        }
        map={
          <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center bg-muted text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Map SDK renderer slot
          </div>
        }
        panel={
          <div className="p-6">
            <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">Selected place</h2>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Panel content remains independently scrollable.
            </p>
          </div>
        }
      />
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## AdaptiveMapShell

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `AdaptiveMapShellProps`, which extends `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>`.

- `map`: `React.ReactNode`, **required**.
- `mapLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Map"`.
- `mapStatus`: `MapReadiness`, optional, default `"ready"`.
- `mapStatusContent`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `controls`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `controlsBottomStart`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.

  Logical bottom corners above the panel. Wide clusters wrap without overlapping.

- `controlsBottomEnd`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `attribution`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.

  Measured map credits above sheets, centered across the full map independently of side panels.

- `bottomControlsPadCamera`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.

  Opt in to conservative bottom camera padding for the measured corner region.

- `topBar`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `panel`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `panelHeader`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.

  Drawn under the sheet's grip and above the panel's content, and not
  scrolled with it: a search field, the assistant button, or a chosen
  category stays put while the results under it scroll (row 73). Every
  detent counts it: a sheet fitted to its content includes it, and a
  collapsed sheet is always tall enough to show all of it — a header that
  fits leaves the collapsed detent where it was, and a taller one raises
  it. A peek anchor, in the header or the content, still decides where a
  collapsed sheet rests.

  A vertical drag on it moves the sheet, whatever the content has
  scrolled; a sideways one stays with the header, for a row of chips
  that scrolls. Under a grab handle it keeps its first control clear of
  the handle's target (WCAG 2.5.8). In a side panel it is the panel's
  first row.

- `panelLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Map details"`.
- `panelHandleLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Panel height"`.

  The sheet handle's accessible name. It is a slider, and "Panel height" is
  the only thing a screen reader has to go on — in English, whatever
  language the interface is in.

- `panelPlacement`: `"start" | "end"`, optional, default `"end"`.
- `panelPresentation`: `MapPanelPresentation`, optional, default `"auto"`.
- `panelDetents`: `readonly PanelDetent[]`, optional.

  Where a bottom sheet may rest: collapsed (a fifth of the shell, or the
  content's peek anchor), medium (54 %), large (94 %), fitted to its
  content, a fraction or a height. Dragged anywhere on the sheet, it snaps
  to the nearest of these; its content scrolls only at the largest. Unset,
  the sheet offers collapsed, medium and large and rests at medium.

- `panelDetent`: `PanelDetent`, optional.

  The detent the sheet rests at: controlled, with `onPanelDetentChange`.

- `defaultPanelDetent`: `PanelDetent`, optional.

  The detent an uncontrolled sheet starts at.

- `onPanelDetentChange`: `(detent: PanelDetent) => void`, optional.
- `panelFraction`: `number`, optional.

  A single-detent shorthand: the sheet rests at this fraction (0.12–0.94) and offers no other.

- `panelSizing`: `"fraction" | "content"`, optional, default `"fraction"`.

  A single-detent shorthand: fitted to its content — as tall as what it
  holds, between collapsed and large — for a sheet that holds a summary and
  a row of buttons and nothing to scroll.

- `panelSurface`: `SurfaceVariant`, optional, default `"solid"`.

  What the panel sits on: solid by default, glass where the product asks for it.

- `collisionInsets`: `Partial<MapCollisionInsets>`, optional.

  Minimum renderer padding. Combined with measured chrome using max, not addition.

- `safeAreaInsets`: `Partial<MapCollisionInsets>`, optional.

  Shell-local exclusions the map and the panel both keep out of, e.g. a
  keyboard. The device's own safe areas (CSS env()) are not these: the map
  runs under them and the chrome keeps them.

- `deviceSafeAreaInsets`: `Partial<MapCollisionInsets>`, optional.

  The device's own safe areas, which the chrome keeps out of and the map
  runs under. Defaults to CSS `env(safe-area-inset-*)`, and the larger of
  the two wins, so passing them can only ever add room.

  A prop because `env()` is not always the truth: inside a device frame on a
  canvas, in a web view whose host draws its own bar, or anywhere system
  chrome is painted over a page that reports zero, the controls end up under
  the status bar with nothing able to say so (GAP-077).

- `controlsPadCamera`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.

  Whether the floating controls pad the camera through
  `onCollisionInsetsChange`. Off by default.

  Collision insets are four edge bands, so a 44px control column asked the
  camera to give up the whole edge it sat on, at every height — measured at
  120px on a phone. A map following the visitor put them well off centre,
  and the map shifted whenever the location button widened to show its mode
  (GAP-079). A panel or a top bar really does span its edge; a small
  floating cluster does not.

  The controls stay in the snapshot's `occlusions` with their true bounds,
  so a product that wants to fit around them still can — and this stays a
  boolean rather than a variant because it is camera behaviour, which no
  Figma axis could ever carry.

- `usableRegions`: `readonly MapLayoutRect[]`, optional.

  Hinge-free physical rectangles in shell-local CSS pixels. Omit for a continuous host.

- `onCollisionInsetsChange`: `(insets: MapCollisionInsets) => void`, optional.
- `onLayoutChange`: `(layout: AdaptiveMapLayoutSnapshot) => void`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### MapReadiness

From `@kozmos-ds/product-contracts`.

```ts
type MapReadiness = "loading" | "ready" | "error" | "offline" | "unsupported";
```

### MapPanelPresentation

From `@kozmos-ds/product-contracts`.

```ts
type MapPanelPresentation = "auto" | "bottom" | "side";
```

### PanelDetent

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
/** Where the bottom sheet can rest. */
type PanelDetent =
  /** A peek: a fifth of the shell, or the content's peek anchor (`panelPeekAnchor`). */
  | "collapsed"
  /** The resting height, where the map and the sheet share the shell. */
  | "medium"
  /** Nearly the whole shell, for reading a long sheet. */
  | "large"
  /** As tall as the sheet's content, between collapsed and large. */
  | "content"
  /** A share of the shell's height. */
  | {
      fraction: number;
    }
  /** An exact height in pixels. */
  | {
      height: number;
    };
```

### SurfaceVariant

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
/**
 * What a surface is made of. Solid — the background colour with the subtle
 * border — is the default everywhere; glass, the glass surface role composed
 * from `Semantics.Effect.glass`, is a choice a product makes per surface.
 */
type SurfaceVariant = "solid" | "glass";
```

### MapCollisionInsets

From `@kozmos-ds/product-contracts`.

```ts
interface MapCollisionInsets {
  top: number;
  right: number;
  bottom: number;
  left: number;
}
```

### MapLayoutRect

From `@kozmos-ds/product-contracts`.

```ts
/** Physical rectangle in the shell's local units (CSS px, points or dp). */
interface MapLayoutRect {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}
```

### AdaptiveMapLayoutSnapshot

From `@kozmos-ds/product-contracts`.

```ts
interface AdaptiveMapLayoutSnapshot extends AdaptiveMapLayout {
  occlusions: readonly MapOcclusion[];
  /** Physical edge padding relative to mapBounds, NOT relative to the shell. */
  collisionInsets: MapCollisionInsets;
}
```

### AdaptiveMapLayout

From `@kozmos-ds/product-contracts`.

```ts
/** Presentation geometry only: selection, camera and route state belong to the host. */
interface AdaptiveMapLayout {
  /** Renderer bounds relative to the shell, not the screen. */
  mapBounds: MapLayoutRect;
  panelBounds: MapLayoutRect | null;
  presentation: "bottom" | "side" | "separated";
}
```

### MapOcclusion

From `@kozmos-ds/product-contracts`.

```ts
interface MapOcclusion {
  kind: "panel" | "top-bar" | "controls" | "attribution";
  /** Shell-local bounds; intersect with mapBounds before sending to a renderer. */
  bounds: MapLayoutRect;
}
```

## Also exported

- `panelPeekAnchorProps`: `{ readonly "data-kozmos-peek-anchor": "" }`. Marks the row the sheet's smallest detent rests on: spread onto that element.
- `DEFAULT_PANEL_DETENTS`: `readonly PanelDetent[]`. The detents a bottom sheet offers unless told otherwise; it rests at medium.
- `PANEL_DETENT_RULES` (const).

  ```ts
  const PANEL_DETENT_RULES: {
    readonly collapsed: 0.2;
    readonly medium: 0.54;
    readonly large: 0.94;
    /** A collapsed sheet still has to fit the handle and a header row. */
    readonly collapsedFloor: 112;
    /** …but never takes more than this of a short shell. */
    readonly collapsedCap: 0.4;
    /** An anchored peek stays within these shares of the shell. */
    readonly peekFloor: 0.24;
    readonly peekCap: 0.72;
    /** The margin under a peek anchor. */
    readonly peekMargin: 16;
    /** Outside this range there is either no map or no sheet worth showing. */
    readonly minFraction: 0.12;
    readonly maxFraction: 0.94;
  };
  ```

- `PanelDetentMeasures` (interface).

  ```ts
  interface PanelDetentMeasures {
    /** The sheet's content height, for the content detent; 0 until measured. */
    contentHeight?: number;
    /** The bottom edge of the content's peek anchor from the sheet's top; 0 when none. */
    peekBottom?: number;
    /**
     * The bottom edge of the sheet's panel header from the sheet's top; 0 when
     * there is none. A floor for the collapsed detent, not an anchor: see
     * `panelDetentHeight`.
     */
    headerBottom?: number;
  }
  ```

- `anchoredCollapsedHeight`: `(peekBottom: number, shellHeight: number) => number`. The collapsed detent when the content marks a peek anchor.
- `panelDetentHeight`: `(detent: PanelDetent, shellHeight: number, measures?: PanelDetentMeasures) => number`. A detent's height in a shell of `shellHeight` pixels.
- `panelDetentEquals`: `(a: PanelDetent, b: PanelDetent) => boolean`.
- `orderPanelDetents`: `(detents: readonly PanelDetent[], shellHeight: number, measures?: PanelDetentMeasures) => PanelDetent[]`. The offered detents in ascending height, one per distinct height.
- `nearestPanelDetent`: `(detents: readonly PanelDetent[], height: number, shellHeight: number, measures?: PanelDetentMeasures) => PanelDetent | undefined`. The offered detent closest to a height: where a drag snaps once it ends.
- `PanelDragKind` (type). What a drag that starts on the sheet does, decided once at its first move.

  ```ts
  /** What a drag that starts on the sheet does, decided once at its first move. */
  type PanelDragKind = "content" | "sheet";
  ```

- `decidePanelDrag`: `(input: { dx: number; dy: number; atLargestDetent: boolean; scrollTop: number }) => PanelDragKind`. The prototype's rule: a sideways move is the content's; at the largest detent an upward drag scrolls the content, and a downward one scrolls it back to its top before the sheet moves; below the largest detent every vertical drag moves the sheet.
- `PANEL_DRAG_SLOP`: `= 6`. Movement below this reads as a tap rather than a drag.
- `panelDetentDescription`: `(detent: PanelDetent) => string`.
